question: How many forms of ritual nakedness are traditionally recognized in dress?
premises: Single-tucked dress is a form of nakedness
Untucked dress is a form of nakedness
inference: Tradition classifies ritual nakedness into five distinct forms.
uncertainties: Only two of the five forms are explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: One with a single tuck and one without a tuck are considered naked; nakedness is remembered as fivefold.
